lines.zh: 我这副身体太大，走起来地都在响。
lines.en: This body is huge; the ground rings as I walk.
Over four blocks tall, and slow to walk.
One stride crosses a whole ditch.

lines.zh: 我的履带一样的脚压过草地。
lines.en: My tread-like feet press the grass flat.
I walk toward the village.
I go around a hill without climbing it.

lines.zh: 我身上的废铁互相碰着响。
lines.en: The scrap iron on me clatters.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，土都被压实。
lines.en: The soil packs hard where I pass.

lines.zh: 我在草原上走，影子很大。
lines.en: I cross the plains, my shadow vast.

lines.zh: 我停下来的时候，整片地方都静。
lines.en: When I stop, the whole area goes quiet.
I cross the jungle, and trees snap.
Turning is slow. I am too large.
I stand, and the iron on me creaks.

lines.zh: 我这一身是用废料拼的。
lines.en: This whole body is welded from scrap.
I swallow an old sheet of iron.
I am a perfect form.
There is a muzzle in my mouth.
I listen to something far away.
I shudder and iron filings fall.
I stood by the fields a while.
A four-block Valvemon is wide.
My breathing is slow, like a bellows.

lines.zh: 我记得自己吃过很多废铁。
lines.en: I remember eating a great deal of scrap.
You are smaller than one of my feet.
What do you want me to haul?
One step brings me to you.
My voice is muffled.
Step back. I fear I will tread on you.

lines.zh: 我这副身体，是拼起来的。
lines.en: This body was assembled.
Do you want to see my cannon?
I have pulled a plough and rolled a yard.

lines.zh: 你会不会被我的影子吓到。
lines.en: Does my shadow frighten you?
This body cannot crouch.
Speak louder.
My hearing is not good.

lines.zh: 你手上的东西，我看不清。
lines.en: I cannot see what you hold.

lines.zh: 我整个身体转过来，地面发闷。
lines.en: My whole bulk turns and the ground groans.
A few plates fell off.
I sway, then set.
That hit my ribs.
I am too heavy to retreat quickly.
A four-block shell gives a muffled sound.
This damage can be repaired.
I stay planted here.
You picked an awkward spot.
I have noted it.
Knock once more.
Scrap iron? Is that scrap iron?
Give it to me.
This is nothing much.
My teeth can manage it.
Just throw it into my mouth.
That iron is one gulp.
I am not fussy. Any iron.
This one is too soft.
I want the one in your hand too.

lines.zh: 你撞在我腿上，像撞墙基。
lines.en: You hit my leg like a foundation.

lines.zh: 我这四格多的身子，连晃都没晃。
lines.en: Four blocks plus of body, and I did not even sway.
Move; my foot is coming down.
That threw you far.

lines.zh: 你踩在我脚背上，像粒沙。
lines.en: You stepped on my instep like a grain of sand.
Do not crowd my feet.
I turn slowly. Be careful.
Again, and I press down.
Not with this body.
My kind are rarely seen.
I only want somewhere to stay.
I am more at ease in the fields.
I take up too much room.
Then forget it.
I should be on my way.
Stay where you are.
I pick up a whole sheet of scrap.
It is like paper in my hand.
I fold it once.
This one is a little hard.
I knock it once.
It rings nicely.
This weight is nothing.

lines.zh: 你还有别的吗？舱门还开着。
lines.en: Got anything else? The hatch is open.
You are standing over there.
I turn my head.
One footfall reaches you.
Too late to back away.
Walking is enough.
A courtyard wall behind you.
Three counts before my foot falls.
One foot, then two.
Now the third.
I raise my muzzle.
You run; I can still see you.
You circle the house; I circle the house.

lines.zh: 我这块影子，够你站半天。
lines.en: My shadow is big enough for you to stand in.
No hurry. My legs are long.
You went into an alley.
Too narrow. I cannot get in.
I wait here at the alley mouth.
You came out the back.
I turn slowly, but I can see.
One more step.
You are at my feet.
My foot comes down and the soil gives first.
I bring my fist down.
My muzzle lights up.
This blow is heavy.
You cannot block it, only dodge.
You roll several times.
A kick takes out a wall.
You are slapped to the ground.
My iron fist is hard.
Still standing. I will come slower next time.
I pull my foot back a step.
That was all of it.

lines.zh: 我从一堆废铁里站起来。
lines.en: I rise out of a heap of scrap.

lines.zh: 铁片一块块贴到我身上。
lines.en: Plates of iron cling to me.
I stand taller than the trees around.
The first thing I see is the plains.

lines.zh: 我试着走了一步，地响了。
lines.en: I try one step; the ground answers.
My muzzle is still empty.

lines.zh: 我记得自己在田里干过活。
lines.en: I remember working in fields.
I remember eating a lot of iron.
I head for the nearest village.
My feet break the fence.
I try to keep to the road.
From here, I walk slowly.
Fire heats my iron; I glow.

lines.zh: 我摔下去，砸出一个大坑。
lines.en: I fall and make a large crater.
Water floods in and I grow heavy.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀得侧了一步。
lines.en: The blast shoves me one step sideways.

lines.zh: 有东西卡在我的铁缝里。
lines.en: Something is stuck in a seam of my iron.

lines.zh: 咒力钻进铁里，我的关节卡住。
lines.en: The curse enters the iron and my joints seize.

lines.zh: 没有废铁，我的身体在响。
lines.en: No scrap, and my body creaks.

lines.zh: 雷打在铁上，走遍我全身。
lines.en: Lightning hits the iron and runs through me.
No ground below; I keep falling.
